newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Useage of Schiphol Freight Message System grows 15.
newsitem.headline: Useage of Schiphol Freight Message System grows 15.

text.p: Cargonaut, the electronic messaging system for the Dutch airfreight industry, was used roughly 1.5 million times in the last twelve months.

Arno Hoitink, managing director of Cargonaut BV, the Schiphol-based software house which operates the system, told Reuters there has been an "encouraging" growth in the number of electronic messages transmitted by the system in 1996. Last year, Cargonaut carried some 1.3 million messages.

In a telephone interview, Hoitink said the 1996 figure is provisional. He said the growth of use of the system reflects the increasing functionality of the messaging system, which carries electronically airfreight status messages, reservation messages, import declarations and which enables the electronic exchange of airway bills between user companies.
Some 70 forwarding agents and the 15 top cargo airlines at Schiphol airport are the co-shareholders and users of the Cargonaut system. Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
